items.title: Forget Being a Landlord: These 3 REITs Pay You to Own Apartments
items.summary: Apartment REITs are legally required to hand most of their income straight to shareholders, but not all of them are equally safe bets right now. Three landlords are collecting rent checks while new construction dries up, and the differences between them could cost you real money.

items.title: Are Wall Street Analysts Predicting Camden’s Stock Will Climb or Sink?
items.summary: Camden has underperformed the broader market over the past year, and Wall Street remains cautious about the stock.

items.title: Renters Are Staying Put. These 4 Apartment REITs Could Benefit
items.summary: Fewer renters are buying homes, and apartment landlords are quietly collecting the payoff. We checked four REIT dividends against their cash flow, and the one paying the most has the thinnest safety margin. Two coastal giants didn't make the cut.
